name: screenhistory
displayName: Screen history — every past iteration of every screen
description: Sets up and drives atlas-review against a Revyl app: build-over-build image diffs of every Atlas screen, commit/PR/author provenance, first-changed-build blame, approvals and comments, policy alerts for CI, and a self-contained HTML report that runs the detector in the browser so any build pair can be compared in either direction.
